Although Getty agreed to divest the editorial and stock content businesses in Phase 1, the CMA had questions about the scope of the remedy. news.title: Microsoft CEO Warns That Companies Embracing AI Could Drive Themselves Out of Business
news.snippet: More on AI: Sam Altman Says Even the Power of AI Will Never Lead to a Shorter Wo...
news.raw_snippet:
More on AI: Sam Altman Says Even the Power of AI Will Never Lead to a Shorter Work Week [...] Can’t-miss innovations from the bleeding edge of science and tech

The business world has quickly learned that there’s such a thing as using too much AI, as they get slammed with outrageous token bills.

Now, Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella is warning of another way that embracing AI could doom a business.

In an interview Sunday, Nadella cautioned against sharing too much information, ranging from proprietary data to the prompts entered, with a third-party AI model. [...] That’s a striking claim — and an ironic one, since outsourcing your thinking is arguably exactly the point of using AI, of which Microsoft is a leading vendor. Nadella, in a nutshell, is saying that heavily relying on proprietary AI software could also be a company’s undoing.

Andrew Ng is the Founder ofDeepLearning.AI, Managing General Partner at AI Fund, Managing Partner at AI Aspire, Executive Chairman of LandingAI, Chairman and Co-Founder of Coursera, and an Adjunct Professor at Stanford University. As a pioneer in machine learning and online education, Dr. Ng has changed countless lives through his work in AI. Over 8 million people have taken an AI class from him. He served as VP & Chief Scientist at Baidu, where he led a 1,300-person AI team responsible for the company's AI technology and strategy.
